display_information.name: scribe
display_information.description: Send a link, PDF, or image; get a summary in thread and a full note in your Obsidian vault.
display_information.long_description:
Send scribe a link, PDF, or image — as a direct message, or by @-mentioning it in a channel. It extracts the text (reading a PDF's text layer where there is one, and falling back to OCR only for scans), writes a thorough summary, and saves a note to the Obsidian vault inbox.

You get a short TL;DR back in the thread, along with a link that opens the note directly in Obsidian on your phone or laptop.

Everything runs on self-hosted hardware — no document ever leaves the network. Because summarization runs on CPU, a long article takes several minutes; documents are handled one at a time and scribe reports your position in the queue. Send "help" for a reminder of any of this.
